name: Wisdom And Knowledge
overview: Scripture reveals that true wisdom and knowledge originate from the fear of the LORD, which is the foundational principle for understanding and living rightly, as emphasized in Psalms 111:10 and Proverbs 1:7. Wisdom and knowledge are gifts given by God, flowing from His mouth and resting upon the Messiah by the Spirit of the LORD, who brings wisdom, understanding, counsel, might, and reverence for God (Isaiah 11:2; Proverbs 2:6). These divine gifts not only provide protection and guidance but also impart life to those who embrace them, highlighting the vital role of God's commandments and instruction in cultivating a godly mind and heart (Ecclesiastes 7:12; Proverbs 2:1).
